items.title: Jon Hendricks interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I’m also trying to get a transcript of the screenplay to “Lawrence of Arabia” by Robert Bolt. Best screenwriting in the history of film.

ctx.x: Can we put this over here?

Sure. I’m also trying to get a transcript of the screenplay to “Lawrence of Arabia” by Robert Bolt. Best screenwriting in the history of film. It’s so beautiful, the language. I don’t know how many times you’ve watched that movie.
A couple of times I’ve seen it, yeah.
